records.name: Felicija
records.facts_used: Senn–Salys PDF 228 / printed 213: Felicija PN = Felizia. Salys PDF 54 / printed 39: Poles translated Latin Felix/Felicia as Szczęsny/Szczęsna. PDF 57 / printed 42 with tables PDF 53, 56: Felicija occurs once among noblewomen in the 1575–1587 Raseiniai land-court records. Guide: Latin felix.
records.reason: Exact-form evidence supports a reviewed history in five languages.
records.uncertainties: Pages visually checked. The court-record count is Salys’s compilation; the original acts were not inspected. Not a first attestation.
